'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Better Save Soul]] DLC item. Decayed souls will become {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s in [[Chest]]s, [[Corpse]]s, etc. The other source of Sin Shards is through soul cleansing with the [[Soul healer]] in the [[Souls room]]. This workstation can provide several {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s equal to the used [[Items#Bodyparts|body parts]] during cleansing operations.

Each Sin Shard stored in a Soul Container passively increases the maximum Soul Gratitude you can store by one. 

Souls via the Soul healer will always have either 4 or 7 sins to heal. Thus, healing souls will always give either 4 or 7 {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s. You can double this through the sermon "Prayer for Soul's Thorough Cleansing", giving you either 8 or 14 {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s instead. What causes a soul to have either 4 or 7 sins is how many organs are used to cleanse it. 

{{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s become a highly important and valuable resource in the late-game as they are necessary to perfect your Graveyard and your Zombies. Through the Organ Enhancer, you can cause all organs, except the Skull and Bone, to give {{Skull|white}}, including Fat and Blood. 

The maximum amount of skulls, {{Skull|red}} or {{Skull|white}}, any organ can have is 3. {{Item|Flesh}} and {{Item|Skin}} can be perfected by improving each unit twice in the Organ Enhancer. {{Item|Blood}} and {{Item|Fat}} can be perfected by improving each unit 4 times.  

* It will cost 2 {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s to improve a -1 {{Skull|white}} part to a 0 {{Skull|white}} part 
* It will cost another 2 {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s to improve a 0 {{Skull|white}} part to a +1 {{Skull|white}} part 
* 3 {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s to improve a +1 {{Skull|white}} part to a +2 {{Skull|white}} part 
* 4 {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s to improve a +2 {{Skull|white}} part to a +3 {{Skull|white}} part 

This means that it will cost 11 {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}} to perfect 1 unit of {{Item|Blood}} or {{Item|Fat}}, and 7 {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s to perfect 1 unit of {{Item|Flesh}} or {{Item|Skin}}. In total, it will cost 36 {{Item|{{PAGENAME}}}}s to perfect these parts.
